# Game Idea: Nebula Escape

- **Gameplay**: Player pilots a ship through a scrolling nebula field on an HTML canvas, dodging asteroids and clouds.
- **Goal**: Collect glowing energy orbs to boost score.
- **Lose Condition**: Colliding with an obstacle or running out of fuel ends the game.

1: // Simple Nebula Escape game targeting <canvas id="game"></canvas>
2: (() => {
3:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
4:   if (!canvas) return console.error('Canvas #game not found');
5:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
6:   // Audio assets
7:   const sounds = {
8:     collect: new Audio('collect.wav'),
9:     crash: new Audio('crash.wav'),
10:     bg: new Audio('bg.mp3')
11:   };
12:   sounds.bg.loop = true;
13:   // start background after first user interaction
14:   let audioStarted = false;
15:   const startAudio = () => {
16:     if (!audioStarted) {
17:       sounds.bg.play().catch(()=>{});
18:       audioStarted = true;
19:     }
20:   };
21:   window.addEventListener('keydown', startAudio, { once: true });
22:   canvas.width = canvas.clientWidth || 800;
23:   canvas.height = canvas.clientHeight || 600;
24: 
25:   const ship = { x: 50, y: canvas.height / 2, w: 30, h: 20, speed: 4 };
26:   let score = 0,
27:     fuel = 100,
28:     obstacles = [],
29:     orbs = [],
30:     stars = [],
31:     keys = {};
32: 
33:   const random = (min, max) => Math.random() * (max - min) + min;
34:   const collide = (a, b) => a.x < b.x + b.w && a.x + a.w > b.x && a.y < b.y + b.h && a.y + a.h > b.y;
35: 
36:   const spawnObstacle = () => {
37:     const size = random(20, 40);
38:     obstacles.push({ x: canvas.width, y: random(0, canvas.height - size), w: size, h: size, speed: random(2, 5) });
39:   };
40:   const spawnOrb = () => {
41:     const size = 15;
42:     orbs.push({ x: canvas.width, y: random(0, canvas.height - size), w: size, h: size, speed: 2 });
43:   };
44: 
45:   // initialize stars
46:   const initStars = () => {
47:     for (let i = 0; i < 100; i++) {
48:       stars.push({
49:         x: random(0, canvas.width),
50:         y: random(0, canvas.height),
51:         speed: random(0.2, 0.6),
52:         alpha: random(0.5, 1)
53:       });
54:     }
55:   };
56:   initStars();
57: 
58:   const update = () => {
59:     // movement
60:     if (keys['ArrowUp']) ship.y -= ship.speed;
61:     if (keys['ArrowDown']) ship.y += ship.speed;
62:     if (keys['ArrowLeft']) ship.x -= ship.speed;
63:     if (keys['ArrowRight']) ship.x += ship.speed;
64:     ship.y = Math.max(0, Math.min(canvas.height - ship.h, ship.y));
65:     ship.x = Math.max(0, Math.min(canvas.width - ship.w, ship.x));
66: 
67:     // obstacles
68:     obstacles.forEach(o => o.x -= o.speed);
69:     obstacles = obstacles.filter(o => o.x + o.w > 0);
70:     // orbs
71:     orbs.forEach(o => o.x -= o.speed);
72:     orbs = orbs.filter(o => o.x + o.w > 0);
73:     // stars (parallax background)
74:     stars.forEach(s => s.x -= s.speed);
75:     stars = stars.filter(s => s.x > 0);
76: 
77:     // collisions
78:     obstacles.forEach(o => {
79:       if (collide(ship, o)) {
80:         gameOver();
81:       }
82:     });
83:     orbs.forEach((o, i) => {
84:       if (collide(ship, o)) {
85:         score += 10;
86:         fuel = Math.min(100, fuel + 15);
87:         orbs.splice(i, 1);
88:         sounds.collect.currentTime = 0;
89:         sounds.collect.play().catch(()=>{});
90:       }
91:     });
92: 
93:     // fuel drain
94:     fuel -= 0.05;
95:     if (fuel <= 0) gameOver();
96:   };
97: 
98:   const draw = () => {
99:     ctx.clearRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
100:     // background gradient (nebula)
101:     const bgGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, canvas.height);
102:     bgGrad.addColorStop(0, '#001');
103:     bgGrad.addColorStop(1, '#003');
104:     ctx.fillStyle = bgGrad;
105:     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
106:     // stars
107:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
108:     stars.forEach(s => {
109:       ctx.globalAlpha = s.alpha;
110:       ctx.fillRect(s.x, s.y, 1, 1);
111:     });
112:     ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
113:     // ship (triangle)
114:     ctx.fillStyle = '#0f0';
115:     ctx.beginPath();
116:     ctx.moveTo(ship.x, ship.y + ship.h / 2);
117:     ctx.lineTo(ship.x + ship.w, ship.y);
118:     ctx.lineTo(ship.x + ship.w, ship.y + ship.h);
119:     ctx.closePath();
120:     ctx.fill();
121:     // obstacles (asteroid circles with gradient)
122:     obstacles.forEach(o => {
123:       const grad = ctx.createRadialGradient(o.x + o.w / 2, o.y + o.h / 2, o.w / 4, o.x + o.w / 2, o.y + o.h / 2, o.w / 2);
124:       grad.addColorStop(0, '#f44');
125:       grad.addColorStop(1, '#600');
126:       ctx.fillStyle = grad;
127:       ctx.beginPath();
128:       ctx.arc(o.x + o.w / 2, o.y + o.h / 2, o.w / 2, 0, Math.PI * 2);
129:       ctx.fill();
130:     });
131:     // orbs (glowing energy)
132:     ctx.fillStyle = '#ff0';
133:     ctx.shadowColor = '#ff0';
134:     ctx.shadowBlur = 15;
135:     orbs.forEach(o => {
136:       ctx.beginPath();
137:       ctx.arc(o.x + o.w / 2, o.y + o.h / 2, o.w / 2, 0, Math.PI * 2);
138:       ctx.fill();
139:     });
140:     ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
141:     // UI
142:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
143:     ctx.font = '16px sans-serif';
144:     ctx.fillText(`Score: ${Math.floor(score)}`, 10, 20);
145:     ctx.fillText(`Fuel: ${Math.floor(fuel)}`, 10, 40);
146:   };
147: 
148:   let running = true;
149:   const gameOver = () => {
150:     running = false;
151:     // play crash sound
152:     sounds.crash.currentTime = 0;
153:     sounds.crash.play().catch(()=>{});
154:     ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.6)';
155:     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
156:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
157:     ctx.font = '30px sans-serif';
158:     ctx.fillText('Game Over', canvas.width / 2 - 70, canvas.height / 2);
159:     ctx.font = '20px sans-serif';
160:     ctx.fillText(`Final Score: ${Math.floor(score)}`, canvas.width / 2 - 80, canvas.height / 2 + 30);
161:   };
162: 
163:   const loop = () => {
164:     if (!running) return;
165:     update();
166:     draw();
167:     requestAnimationFrame(loop);
168:   };
169: 
170:   // input handling
171:   window.addEventListener('keydown', e => (keys[e.key] = true));
172:   window.addEventListener('keyup', e => (keys[e.key] = false));
173: 
174:   // spawn intervals
175:   setInterval(spawnObstacle, 1500);
176:   setInterval(spawnOrb, 2000);
177: 
178:   // start
179:   requestAnimationFrame(loop);
180: })();

(End of file - total 180 lines)
</content>
